## Highlights since 0.14.0

- **A faster agent panel.** The agent panel now starts Claude before you send your first message, keeps open threads running while they sit idle, and no longer waits for Overleaf comments to refresh before sending. A new thread answers about 2 seconds sooner, and a reply after a pause comes in about half the time. Claude is now the panel's default agent.
- **Your own MCP servers are off in the panel by default.** The agent panel now loads only Lattice's own tools, which is part of what makes it start faster. If you use your own MCP servers with Claude, turn on **Load my MCP servers in Claude** in Settings to bring them back.

## Notable fixes

- The effort level shown in the agent panel is now the one actually sent to the agent.
